## Checklist

- [ ] The PR description contains `Closes #<issue>` (or `No issue: <reason>`)
- [ ] I read my own diff line by line. No debug code, secrets or unrelated changes
- [ ] `npm run lint` and `npm test` pass (and `npm run test:contracts` if I touched `contracts/`)
- [ ] I added or updated tests for the behaviour I changed
- [ ] Docs / README updated if behaviour, setup or addresses changed
- [ ] UI changes work in light and dark mode
